svg.title: Kordelia Vess, Salvage-Marshal of the Cinder Yards

text.tspan: Kordelia Vess, Salvage-Marshal of the Cinder Yards
Slow. This permanent is a Generator attuned to the Mass:
during the Generation Phase, it produces 1 Mass Point,
added to its controller's Mass resource pool. Spent: move
a Materials card from your Wreck to your Hand.
Kordelia Vess has run the Cinder Yards for decades on The
Cindral Reach's oldest law: nothing brought in ever leaves as
